sourceNote: State of the union tiles. Rollout numbers are from the Domo Homebody rollout card (Cal screenshot, 2026-10-01). Bug counts are live Jira queries run 2026-10-01 (project DEV, issuetype Bug, statusCategory != Done, Auto-Triage excluded). Per-track bug buckets are non-overlapping and sum to the total: an issue is assigned to the first matching bucket in order HBG -> Insurance -> Rewards -> App -> Other. Tiles with a null value have no source yet and show who owns the number. Countdown and age tiles are computed from dates at render time.
